author: BBC News
description:
Iranian-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen have launched a wave of missiles and drone strikes against Israel.

The group said in a statement that it had targeted "sensitive Israeli military sites" and vowed to continue such attacks. Israel said it had shot down two missiles coming from Yemen.

The entry of the powerful Iranian proxy into the conflict raises fears of further disruption to the world economy as the armed group has capacity to attack shipping in the Red Sea.

The vital shipping route is being used by some tankers as an alternative to the Strait of Hormuz, which Iran has closed with strikes on commercial vessels.  Israel said it was prepared for a “multi-front war" and would strike back.

In the United States there have been mass protests against the war, but President Trump has insisted the fight will continue against Iran.

title: Iran War escalates as Yemen's Houthis attack Israel and threaten Red Sea | BBC News

author: BBC News
description:
The Iranian-backed Houthis in Yemen have fired a missile at Israel for the first time since the start of the US-Israeli war on Iran.

The Israeli military said a missile was aimed at the southern city of Beersheba. It was shot down and there were no casualties, but the involvement of the Houthis may cause future issues for the US and Israel. One month into the war, there is still no sign of any end to the fighting, despite US President Donald Trump's claims that talks with Iran are going “very well”.

description:
More than one million people in Lebanon have been forced to leave their homes as Israel has intensified its attacks on the country in its campaign against the Iranian-backed group Hezbollah.
 
With one in five people in the country now displaced, shelters are overwhelmed and many families have ended up sleeping in cars or tents. Among them are children, the elderly and pregnant women.

The BBC's Middle East correspondent Hugo Bachega spends the day with some of those displaced by this war in Beirut.

author: BBC News
description:
The Iranian backed Houthis in Yemen have confirmed they have attacked Israel for the first time since the start of the US-Israel war with Iran. 
 
The group said it fired a barrage of ballistic missiles "targeting sensitive Israeli military sites" in response to the targeting of infrastructure in Iran, Lebanon, Iraq and Palestinian territories. 
 
It added that its operations will continue until the "aggression" on all fronts ends.
 
It comes after the Israel Defense Forces said it intercepted a missile from Yemen.

description:
Germany’s most senior soldier has told the BBC that the threat from Russia has never been more urgent.
 
General Carsten Breuer, head of Germany's armed forces, is urging Western leaders to “join the dots” on the war in Iran and the Russia invasion of Ukraine.
 
Breuer tells the BBC's Special Correspondent Allan Little, how he is rapidly turning Germany’s military into the most powerful conventional force in Europe.

Warning: This video contains details some viewers may find distressing.
 
Cold-blooded, brutal and outlandish - if the plan Stephen McCullagh set in motion to kill his pregnant partner was the plot of one of his video games, it might have been dismissed as being too far-fetched.
 
But, from the content creator's first appearance in court in early 2023, it was clear authorities believed he had not only murdered Natalie McNally but also carefully constructed an elaborate house of cards to avoid justice.
 
Three years after being charged, a five-week trial exposed his lies to a jury.
